purpose: Turn IMA from a capability-rich project into a measurable public product without creating a parallel system.
market_promise: Give IMA a real human need; IMA helps clarify, verify, create or route to the next useful action while preserving human agency.
rules: No fabricated user, traffic, retention or revenue claims.
A campaign is successful only when measured beyond a page view.
The public promise must describe an observable user job, not AGI or future capability.
Authentication remains the gateway to personal chat and continuity.
Referral links preserve the same canonical IMA experience; no duplicate product surfaces.
Free entry should prove value before asking for payment.
Paid offers are experiments until payment and retention evidence exist.
Every market improvement must feed the canonical continuous-improvement loop.

success_conditions.activation: A new visitor selects a real job, signs in and reaches a useful answer.
success_conditions.retention: A user returns and starts another meaningful job.
success_conditions.referral: A user intentionally shares a job-specific IMA link.
success_conditions.revenue: A user or organization pays for a validated offer with measured value.

next_measurement: Verify deployed analytics ingestion and compare landing -> first-use -> useful-answer -> return rates before scaling spend.
